messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sketch of a one-page onboarding runbook: 'WarmBridge priming' — low-impact priming that warms KV caches, produces an early quality signal, and captures optional customer feedback. Keep it short for SE adoption.
Anya Patel: nice. can you list the 4 minimal steps so SEs can copy/paste?
Maria Chen: Steps: 1) Create a priming job with internal key scoped to priming budgets. 2) Run 0.2-1 r/s for 24-48h using a 6-prompt mini-bundle. 3) Tag traces with warmbridge:onboard and retention:24h; store only hashes + confs. 4) Compute daily "warmbridge_score" (conf_avg, p95_latency_delta, feedback_sentiment) and surface a one-line verdict to CSMs.
Anya Patel: curl example for SEs? keep creds placeholder.
Maria Chen: curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/priming" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PRIM_KEY}" -d '{"tenant":"acct-YYY-warm","prompts":"mini-6","qps":"0.5","duration_h":24,"tags":["warmbridge:onboard","retention:24h"]}'
Dan Li: SRE: enforce priming cache namespace prefix: priming/{tenant} so prod cache keys don't collide. Add circuit-breaker: stop job if 5xx_rate > 1% for 5m or p95 latency rises >150ms vs baseline for 10m. Limit concurrent priming jobs per pool.
Jordan (PM): For CSMs, keep metrics digestible: warmbridge_score, top cause (latency/conf/feedback), short snapshot link. If score < 0.4 => auto-open triage ticket and tag renewal-risk.
Liam O'Neill: Alert hook: POST minimal payload to /hooks/cs-alerts {tenant, score, cause, snapshot}. Also include a quick template for Zendesk. Ops: keep feedback opt-in and clear consent language.
deploy-bot: priming-service v1.7 deployed -> success (build #5012). :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: I'll write the one-pager + 2-sentence email template for SEs. Pilot with two trial accounts next week and collect feedback. Keep runbook one page, include opt-out instructions.
